formative_worksheets.title: The Frequency and Scale Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming frequency table and scaled bar before mean.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can build a frequency table and read a scaled bar.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can build a frequency table and read a scaled bar.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Build a frequency table from a tally chart.

image_placeholders.description: Tally chart + blank frequency table for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_TABLE at Prompt 1: keywords name the activity.

prompts.prompt: Scale: 1 unit = 5. Bar at 4 units = ? children.

image_placeholders.description: A bar graph illustration with a bar at 4 units. Scale labelled 1 unit = 5. Below: '___ children' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_SCALE at Prompt 2: keywords name the activity.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 3 formative check.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My G3 Data Detective Reflection

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
